_comment: K, 2026-11-06: 'ดนตรีห้ามซ้ำกัน'. One signature per song — a distinct lead instrument + groove + mix character, so two songs of the same genre are still different music. `scripts/arrangement.py` assigns one per song by the song's index among the songs of its genre and `--check` fails if any id is reused. The pool is 6 per genre so the 4-genre rotation the advisor panel recommended (max 6 songs in a genre) can never collide. `instruments`/`groove`/`mix` are appended to the Flow Music style prompt after the pentatonic clause.
